title: tellmeabout
intention: Akien can dereference any token the system hands him — /tellmeabout <id-or-name> finds the one record it names and presents it in its own words, at its address, with the act it is waiting on.
why: The lived symptom was measured the day the idea landed: the 2026-08-15 curated review handed Akien 17 finding ids and itself recorded that recordverdict <id> alone won't show their bullets — every id he receives today is a question only CC can answer, which is Law 1's defect aimed at the system's one human reader. Akien, verbatim: 'so you gave me d4896172aa8c, but there isn't currently a way for me to look that up. we could have you describe it, but we built something that could reorient you around a specific thing, maybe we need one for me. tellmeabout would be kinda like moreabout, except being just for me, i'm the agency responsible for giving feeback on it.'
traces_to: Law 1 (an id he cannot look up is a settled record he must re-ask CC to re-derive, every time), Law 7 (the records are on disk and loud only to CC — this is a diagnostic surface for their one human reader), Law 5 (the record is presented from its own address, never a copy)

falsifier.proves_green: skill-class invariants: proved (proofs beside the skill a hollow build could not pass — the resolver floor's refuse/not-found/verbatim teeth — run bare and under the tester) + feeds back to origin on failure. Extra gate of the class: the cairnmap derivation gate (cairn cairnmap --gate) — ships only when the help renders it from its charter AND node_classes/skill.json's roster carries it (the class's thrice-recurred newest-members gap; the roster entry is IN scope of this build). Read-only over the stores it presents — it writes to none of them.
falsifier.proves_red: tellmeabout d4896172aa8c prints that finding's data.bullets verbatim with block skill:saveslate, date 2026-08-09, and the answering recordverdict command; tellmeabout orient refuses by listing the tool and the machine; tellmeabout <unknown> says not-found and names the stores searched. Wrong-intent tell: if Akien still has to ask CC to describe ids after it ships, the presentation is not answering its reader.
falsifier.horizon: One skill build: deterministic resolver floor over the record stores (learning-block findings by id prefix, tickets, troubles, decisions/rulings, ideas, charters beside code), SKILL.md, charter, proofs, roster entry. No writes to any presented store; no new stores.
